title: fix(console,data-objectstack,i18n): Setup › Apps reports what the server did with a write (objectui#12300)
body:
Fixes #12300
Clause-②: no

The Setup › Apps page now reports what the server did with each write.

## What changed

**Delete** (`handleDelete`) reads the reset door's answer. On `reset: false` (no customization row existed, so the app already is what its package ships) the page shows a neutral `toast.info` with the server's own sentence in the keyed `{{reason}}` hole, and never says "deleted". When the answer carries no sentence, the hole holds the localized `appManagement.toast.alreadyAtDefault`. A `reset: true` answer keeps the existing success toast.

**Disable, Set as default and the bulk Enable / Disable** save through one helper, `saveApp`. It passes `{ packageId }` (sent as `?package=`) when the served `_packageId` names a package, and calls the three-argument form, unchanged, when it does not. `'sys_metadata'`, the value the server stamps on a package-less row, is read as no package. Set as default saves the outgoing and the incoming default each in its own package's scope.

**After every write** the page re-reads the list in `finally`, so the failure paths re-read too. A Set as default that fails after its demotion landed now shows no default, not the stale one. No row is patched locally; a row leaves the list only when the server stops serving it.

## The producer half: `ObjectStackAdapter` dropped the SDK's options bag

The page writes through `adapter.getClient().meta`, the SDK client. `@objectstack/client` 17.7.0 declares `saveItem(type, name, item, options?)`, and sends its `SaveMetaItemOptions.packageId` as `?package=`. `ObjectStackAdapter.installSaveAdvisoryInterceptor` wrapped that method in a three-parameter function and called the original with three arguments. The fourth was dropped before the SDK saw it, for every caller of the adapter's client (`force`, `mode` and `ifMatch` with it). Passing `{ packageId }` from the page alone would have changed nothing on the wire. The wrapper now takes and forwards the original's own parameter list.

Measured red first: `packages/data-objectstack/src/saveItem.optionsForwarded-12300.test.ts`, run against the unchanged wrapper, answered `Tests 2 failed | 1 passed (3)` with `AssertionError: expected null to be 'com.qa.lanebapp'`. It is green after the change.

## Route choice, and what was measured before it

- At `f0532d8` the four handlers matched the claim's reading: none passed a scope, `deleteItem`'s answer was unread, and no handler kept optimistic row state (each called `refresh()` on success only).
- The console's other package-aware writes (Studio, the metadata editor) send the scope through `MetadataClient.save(type, name, item, { packageId })`, which appends `?package=`. The SDK's `saveItem` takes the same member under the same name and puts the same parameter on the wire. Keeping the page on the SDK client, and repairing the adapter wrapper, leaves its client, authentication and environment resolution as they were. Moving the page to `useMetadataClient()` would have swapped all three for the same wire result.
- The SDK's `deleteItem` returns the door's body as is (the body has no `data` key to unwrap), so `reset` and `message` were already readable; its typed answer is `DeleteMetaItemResponse`. The page's client type is now a `Pick` of the SDK's own `meta` declaration, not a local restatement.
- The DELETE door reads no package scope (only `If-Match`, `state` and `dropStorage`), and the SDK's `DeleteMetaItemOptions` has no package member, so Delete sends none, as the triage direction says.
- On objectstack `origin/main` (`e540e7ff`) the save door keeps the package binding on an `override-artifact` write ("an org overlay OF a packaged item must keep pointing at the package it customizes (ADR-0005)"). So naming the code package on a Disable of a shipped app is the overlay shape the server expects, not only for writable packages.
- Server messages: the page already frames every server sentence in a keyed template with a `{{reason}}` hole and passes the sentence through raw. The neutral notice follows that convention. Two keys are new, `appManagement.toast.nothingToDelete` and `appManagement.toast.alreadyAtDefault`, in all ten packs.

## Clause-② reasoning

`no`. No published type, export or prop moves, and no input is newly accepted. The adapter's `getClient()` already returned a client whose `saveItem` type takes the options bag; the change makes the adapter stop discarding it. The two new locale keys are pack data for two new strings.

## Tests

The new `AppManagementPage.honestWrites-12300.test.tsx` drives the real page against a small model of the door, built from the two answers measured on the card. A save of a package-owned app that names another package, or none, answers 200 onto a row nobody serves. A delete with no customization row answers `reset: false` with a sentence. `refresh` re-reads from that model, so each badge asserted after a write is the served state. It pins the three triage pins, plus Set as default, a bulk toggle, the sentinel and a 200 that changed nothing. The i18n suite pins the keyed frame and the verbatim sentence.

Ablations ran through objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: an anchored mutation, the run wrapped by its trap-armed restore, and the restore proven (blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty).
- Drop the package scope in `saveApp`: `Tests 5 failed | 6 passed (11)`. Red: both packaged Disables, both Set as default cases, the bulk toggle. Green, as they must be: the package-less, sentinel, delete and "200 changed nothing" cases.
- Ignore `reset` in the delete handler: `Tests 4 failed | 18 passed (22)` over the honest-writes and i18n suites, exactly the four `reset: false` cases.
- The wrapper leg queued but never acquired the verify lock, so it is NOT MEASURED as a separate run. The red-first run above is the same mutation (the shipped three-argument wrapper).

At `a8cd5c4`:
- `pnpm exec vitest run apps/console/ packages/data-objectstack/ packages/i18n/`: `Test Files 353 passed (353)`, `Tests 4526 passed | 13 skipped (4539)`.
- `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/console^...' --concurrency=2`: `Tasks: 34 successful, 34 total`.
- `type-check` for `@object-ui/console`, `@object-ui/data-objectstack` and `@object-ui/i18n`: each exit 0, script name echoed. `tsc --listFiles` for data-objectstack includes the new test file.
- ESLint on the 15 touched TS files (`--format json`): 0 errors, 134 warnings, all `no-explicit-any`. The diff removes one (the wrapper's `item: any`) and adds one (the new test's `ds: any`, as its sibling suites spell it). The narrowing is safe: `eslint.config.js` sets no type-aware parser options, and no rule under `eslint-rules/` reads the disk, so this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file.
- Exit 0: `check-changeset-presence`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:new-line-citations`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:metadata-write-doors`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-dead-keys`, `check:i18n-designer-parity`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:unreferenced-sources`. `check-governed-queue-guard --test`: NOT GOVERNED.

NOT MEASURED:
- `check:eager-locale-catalogues`, reason: PREREQUISITE NOT MET. It weighs a built console bundle, and only the dependency closure was built here. CI builds the bundle.
- `tsc --listFiles` for the console, reason: verify-lock queue timeout. The console tsconfig includes `src` with no `exclude`.

## Acceptance notes (observed, not carded)

- Other `app` saves through the SDK also name no package: plugin-designer's Edit App and Create App pages, and app-shell's `useNavigationSync` app save. A package-owned app edited there would land on the same unserved row. Read from source only, not reproduced. Carrier: objectstack-ai/objectstack#23165, whose server-side resolution of the owning package covers every package-less direct save.
- A `reset: true` answer for an app a package ships (an overlay existed and was removed) still toasts "deleted" while the row stays, reset to the package default. Read from the door's contract only, not reproduced; the triage direction covers `reset: false` only. Carrier: none.

The server half, objectstack-ai/objectstack#23165, is out of scope here; the page is right on either server.
